title: release text (18.0.0-next.0): "Existing junction rows are converted into definitions by the ADR-0131 upgrade ceremony" is false under a wall, where the ceremony converts no binding and its rewrite gate refuses until the operator declares the position
body:
Filing gate **①**, class **(b)**, under the **release-text exception**: operator-facing text that is false has shipped in a published release's CHANGELOG. It was read from source at `origin/main` `0b9391b827`, not measured at a door; the exception does not require that.

Filed by `domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_01Q9PZ5Pzqcus4woVvTZwWNU`, from #23542's readings (`os-dev-report` `6180893363`, out-of-scope finding 1). ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

## What is false

`.changeset/pre/15204-s1-position-permission-sets.md:52` shipped as the 18.0.0-next.0 entries in `packages/core/CHANGELOG.md:236`, `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:1565` and `packages/plugins/plugin-security/CHANGELOG.md:486`:

> **Existing junction rows** are converted into definitions by the ADR-0131 upgrade ceremony (`os migrate`), which applies `convertPositionBindingRows`.

That is true under `single`. Under a wall (`group`, `isolated`) it is not:
- `runAuthoredConversion` returns `done` before it reads a single binding (`packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-apply.ts:791`-`:800`).
- The rewrite gate (`verifyReferences`, `:2041`-`:2057`) then refuses every binding whose position the catalog does not declare with those sets.
- That holds until the operator declares the position, in code or through the metadata door as the platform administrator.

The bullet above it (`:51`) covers only organization-authored positions.

## Reader who acts

Triage grades and routes it. Per AGENTS.md, the route for a released entry is a dedicated docs-only PR that amends the released CHANGELOG entries, ⛔ never a rider on a code PR. The ceremony's own walled remedy is #23542, built separately.

`Seam: release-text: CHANGELOG 18.0.0-next.0 "Existing junction rows are converted" → runtime: runAuthoredConversion's walled arm (organization-ownership-apply.ts:791-800) | consumer: operators of walled deployments reading the 18.0 notes`.

## Acceptance (a proposal; triage's call)

The released entries say what holds in each posture:
- **Under `single`,** the ceremony converts the rows.
- **Under a wall,** it converts none. The rewrite gate refuses a binding until the position is declared, with its `permissionSets` naming the bound sets, in the deployment's code or through the metadata door as the platform administrator.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included: `CHANGELOG 18.0.0-next.0 existing junction rows converted by ceremony false under wall walled bindings not converted release note`. It returned 4 hits:
- #23542 (the ceremony's remedy, not the release text);
- #22085 and #19729 (other release-text defects, closed);
- #21745 (unrelated).
None is this.

Dedupe words: junction rows converted ceremony walled release note; 15204-s1 changeset walled bindings not converted; CHANGELOG 18.0.0-next.0 existing junction rows.
